_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Modeling/Analytic Paper. Comprehensive Information-Theoretic analysis of FSO-ISAC limits (Capacity-Distortion Region, C-D). Benchmarks MAP, MLE, and BCRB.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: System schematic (Collocated Tx/Sens Rx, remote Comm Rx, target scattering). Fig 2: Variance/MSE of MAP/MLE vs Tx Signal X. Fig 3: Optimized CDF (Step-like for Sensing, Smooth for Comm) and C-D Region (Pareto trade-off).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: FSO-ISAC with shared time/spectrum. Comm: Point-to-Point (LB/UB Capacity). Sensing: Parameter Estimation (Range) from reflected intensity. Methodology: Information Theoretic C-D regions. Optimization of Input Distribution P_X. Metrics: Rate (Bits/symbol) vs Distortion (MSE).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Capacity saturates ~2.8 bps/Hz (BAA bound). Sensing: MSE ~10^-5 m^2 achievable. Trade-off: Low distortion (< 2*10^-5) collapses capacity. High distortion allows full Comm capacity.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: rigorous derivation of theoretical limits. Addresses non-linear channel/measurement models. Proposed MAP/MLE estimators approach BCRB with large antenna arrays.

bibliographic.title: Optical ISAC: Fundamental Performance Limits and Transceiver Design
bibliographic.authors: Alireza Ghazavi Khorasgani, Mahtab Mirmohseni, Ahmed Elzanaty

application.scenario_description: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) FSO link with simultaneous LiDAR sensing of targets.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Characterization of the optimal Capacity-Distortion (C-D) tradeoff for FSO-ISAC. Derivation of optimal input distributions (Step vs Exponential) and efficient algorithms (BAA-type, Closed-Form) to compute the Pareto boundary.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of information-theoretic performance limits and practical transceiver designs for Optical ISAC accounting for non-linear channel models and signal-dependent noise.

transmitter.notes: Input distribution P_X optimized. High SNR regime approximates Exponential distribution.

receiver.notes: Sensing Rx: 64-element array (8x8). Comm Rx: Single PD.

waveform.notes: Optimization of the scalar intensity distribution P(X) to serve both tasks.

channel_wireless.notes: Generic FSO Channel Model with Atmospheric Turbulence (Gamma-Gamma inferred).

sensing_metrics.notes: MSE of Range Estimation ~10^-5 m^2 (approx 3mm RMSE).

tradeoff.notes: Explicit C-D Region plotted. Strong tradeoff at low distortion levels.
